thread:
kevin_r: quick thread to lock scope for the "lite observability" panel we want in next sprint — keep GA tight.

maria_k: customers ask: one-pane cost view, simple error correlation, trace peek from errors, and a sampling control for noisy routes. many will ask for 30d but pilot customers can accept shorter.

samir: engineering constraints: full trace ingest is expensive. propose trace-peek (lookup by id) + sampling presets. also need to ensure trace_id flows through older ingestion paths.

emily: suggested GA must-haves: (1) route-level cost row with sparkline (7d), (2) error heatmap + top-10 endpoints, (3) trace-peek button that opens trace viewer, (4) sampling presets (low/med/high), (5) PagerDuty webhook hook (MVP).
jordan_p: can we gate 30d behind enterprise plan? that buys us time for infra changes.

samir: yes. Hosted default 7d, Dedicated/Enterprise can opt-in for 30d via config. cheaper ops footprint for GA.
maria_k: rollout plan idea: enable for 5 pilot orgs for 48h, watch tail latency & CPU for 72h, expand if stable. acceptance: <3% median latency increase.
emily: i'll make a compact mock of the row and sampling control and share by EOD.

kevin_r: dev estimates?
jordan_p: rough: cost row + heatmap + trace-peek + sampling presets = ~3 dev-weeks. PD hook + retention UI = ~1 week. 30d retention or full-trace capture are extra.
samir: infra checklist: add sampling flag to routing, preserve trace_id in serializer, circuit-breaker for trace-forwarder, surface KV hit metrics per-route.
maria_k: i'll draft the billing copy for retention warning and loop legal.

opsbot: deploybot: feature gate created: name=obs-lite-rollout, env=staging, owners=[samir,jordan_p]

kevin_r: decision for this thread: ship GA with must-haves above, default 7d, presets for sampling, PD MVP, gate 30d behind enterprise. owners: emily (mock), samir (infra), jordan (API), maria (copy). reconvene in 48h.
